spec.name: Orange Kitchen Sushi Platter
spec.description: A dark glazed ceramic tray with two stepped salmon nigiri, three octagonal maki rolls, sculpted wasabi and folded ginger. Forty-five editable cuboids use one carefully packed 64×64 atlas.

prompt: Generate a polished Minecraft Java 3D sushi platter for Orange SMP Kitchen: a shallow dark ceramic rectangular serving tray, two salmon nigiri with gently stepped rice mounds and striped salmon flesh draped over them, three clearly cylindrical stepped maki pieces with black-green nori skin, rice rings and orange/green centers, tiny wasabi and ginger garnish. Detailed hand-painted vanilla pixel texture shading on every face. Around 35-60 cuboids, a SINGLE 64x64 texture atlas with mapped separate surfaces. x/z0..16 y0..6, bottom y0. Rich warm salmon, ivory rice, dark nori; recognizable from inventory distance. No text, background or scenery; produce a high-quality actual asset, not generic rectangles.
